title: Revalidate PI and quotation to PI master references independently of request shape
description: Remove executable master-reference waivers in PI business commitment. ProformaInvoiceController.RequiresLiveMasterValidation at lines 57-58 and QuotationController.RequiresLivePiMasterValidation at lines 52-53 depend only on Request.Path.HasValue. Thus an otherwise authorized internal call can create/edit/submit/approve/convert a PI with deleted/disabled/nonexistent product/customer/salesman and quotation-to-PI can copy those invalid references. Make the existing ProformaInvoiceMasterReferenceRules mandatory at all established write/commit/conversion entry points regardless of path/context, including inside existing source locks. Current identity and source/menu authority must remain mandatory and non-disclosing. No new master-maintenance grants. Adapt existing fixtures with genuine enabled identities, existing menu grants and live master rows, never a request-path/environment/test bypass. Preserve nullable manual drafts where the established business rules allow them. Full original failure logs and explicit TRX/results directories must remain under .ai/logs/<task>; do not stage generated outputs. No schema changes or new permissions. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: PI create/edit/submit/approve/order conversion and quotation-to-PI always validate explicitly supplied live customer/product/eligible salesman with bounded batched reads, independently of request path. Preserve documented nullable/manual draft behavior, reject invalid explicit references before numbering or writes.

Revalidate persisted references at commitment under current deterministic source locks and transactions, reject master invalidation without partial generated PI/order/status writes, preserve original historical text and prohibit silent reassignment. Existing caller/menu/customer and currency/deposit/quantity rules remain intact.

Rules/controller and real isolated SQL tests cover permitted manual and sourced drafts, deleted/disabled masters between draft and conversion, identical call shapes and denied zero number/mutation effects. Adapt all affected genuine fixtures, pass safe Release/full units, preserve original evidence.
implementation_evidence: ProformaInvoiceController.cs:57-69 and QuotationController.cs:52-63 skip live PI master checks if Request.Path is absent. ERP-473 implements HTTP master validation but retains explicit internal waiver; ERP-487 concerns customer invoice evidence rather than PI.
